paper.source: Ramoneda et al. 2024, Table 3/4, 'RubricNet proposed' / 'Ours', CIPI, basic+LZ descriptors

official_checkpoints.description: Pure inference on the original authors' own released checkpoints + scalers (github.com/PRamoneda/rubricnet, checkpoints/rubricnet_cameraready/), no training performed

retrain_original_hparams.description: From-scratch 5-fold retrain, interpretability.py default hyperparameters (batch=40, lr=0.1, dropout=0.1, decay_lr=0.9), guitar-adapted rubricnet.py code (num_classes>8 branch active), no seed pinned

retrain_pristine_code.description: Same hyperparameters as above, but using rubricnet_original/ (pristine pre-guitar-edit code pulled from this repo's initial commit) instead of the guitar-adapted rubricnet.py, to rule out the num_classes>8 code divergence as the cause of the gap

retuned_hparams.description: 30-trial Optuna search (paper's own stated search space: batch 16-128, dropout 0.1-0.5, decay_lr 0.1-0.9, lr 1e-5-1e-1 log-scale) picking the best-validation trial, retrained with full patience=400

code_divergence_finding.description: rubricnet/rubricnet.py (shared with the guitar project) was modified in commit 'flopping v4' (2026-07-09) to special-case num_classes>8 for the guitar V4/V6 experiments (custom final-layer init, sum-decode instead of cumprod-decode, softened class-weight smoothing). CIPI's paper task also uses 9 classes, so early reproduction runs silently used this guitar-specific code path. Fixing it (retrain_pristine_code above) did not meaningfully change the outcome, ruling it out as the cause of the accuracy gap.

hyperparameter_search_distribution.description: All 30 trials from the Optuna search (patience=30, fast proxy). 'Converged' excludes clear training failures from pathological learning rates.

guitar_cross_check.description: For comparison: whether the guitar project's own hyperparameter choices (from ~170-trial Optuna searches) show the same favorable-tail selection pattern as CIPI's paper number.
guitar_cross_check.conclusion: Unlike CIPI's paper number (z~1.57, top ~6%, 0/19 converged trials matched it), the guitar V3/V5 hyperparameters sit near the average of their own search distributions and are confirmed stable across 3 independent seeds (<1.5 point spread) -- the guitar results are not a comparable favorable-tail artifact.
